headline: NPST wins contract to build super app for Sri Lankan telecom firm
hook: New international contract for Network People
summary: Network People Services Technologies Limited has announced it secured a contract to build a super app for a leading telecom conglomerate in Sri Lanka. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI listing regulations. This cross-border win expands the digital payments and technology company's footprint into the international market. Indian retail investors should note this operational expansion as a potential driver for future overseas revenue growth.
why_it_matters: International expansion could boost future revenue growth for NPST.
